Bouteille_plastique.method: Rinse and place in the plastics recycling bin. Flatten to save space.
tips: Remove the cap and recycle separately if your facility requires it
Check the resin code (number in the triangle) — most PET/HDPE bottles are widely accepted

Brique_en_carton.method: Rinse out any liquid residue and place in the carton/paper recycling stream.
tips: These are multi-layer (paper + plastic + foil) so they need a specialized recycling stream, not regular paper

Emballage_metallique.method: Rinse and place in the metal/cans recycling bin.
tips: Cans and foil are infinitely recyclable — no quality loss
Crush cans to save space if your program allows it

Ordure_ménagère.method: Dispose of in the general waste bin — this item is not recyclable through standard streams.
tips: Check if any part of the item can be separated and recycled before discarding
Consider whether a reusable alternative exists for next time

Papier_Carton.method: Place in the paper/cardboard recycling bin. Keep it dry and free of food residue.
tips: Greasy or food-stained paper (e.g. pizza boxes) often can't be recycled — check locally

Verre.method: Rinse and place in the glass recycling bin, sorted by color if your local facility requires it.
tips: Remove lids/caps — they're usually a different material

unknown.method: Could not confidently classify this item — please check local guidelines manually.
tips: Try a clearer, well-lit photo with the item centered and filling the frame
